verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook includes a built-in AI assistant. Users can chat with it for grounded answers, give it a custom role, and have it generate reports, slide decks, audio and video overviews, quizzes and infographics from their sources. Generations can even be deferred for later. However, the evidence shows only single-request generation and Q&A over user-supplied sources, not open-ended task delegation. A community report also notes it could not search for and pull in docs on its own. missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution or agentic actions beyond source-grounded chat and artifact generation, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegation workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Chat with your notebook to get grounded information based on your sources with clear in-line citations for accuracy, transparency, and trust.
Transform your sources into approachable formats such as study guides, briefings, audio overviews, mind maps, and more.
Create your own, or choose from FAQ, study guide, briefing document, or an AI suggested report type.
When you are out of AI limits, you can now delay generations for later.
